## What's broken

A clear description of the bug. One sentence is fine.

## Where

- **Page / URL**: e.g. `/lorenz/explorer`
- **Locale**: en / de / es / fr / it / pt / sv / no
- **Browser**: e.g. Chrome 124 on macOS, Firefox 125 on Linux

## To reproduce

1. Open the page
2. Click / type / scroll …
3. Observe the bug

## Expected

What did you expect to see?

## Screenshot or recording

Drag a screenshot here. A short screen recording for animation/canvas
bugs is gold.
